description: The lead context an activity was logged in, as it stood on that day — one row per lead-sourced declared field, addressed by that field's own Fieldname. Key-value for the same reason CRM Task Answer is: which lead fields an account asks for differs per account and per grain, so named columns here would be per-account DDL. Separate from CRM Task Answer so the two are never confused: that table is what the rep answered, this one is the context they answered it in. Editing the lead later changes no row here.

fields.description: The declared CRM Task Type Field this row snapshots. It is the row's address: a write targets it and every consumer reads through it.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: The lead's value at the moment this activity was logged, always populated. A multi-select value holds every value, joined with a comma.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: The same value as a real Datetime when the declared fieldtype is one, so a filter or a sort compares dates rather than strings.
fields.label: Value (Datetime)

fields.description: The same value as a real number when the declared fieldtype is one, so a filter or a sort compares magnitudes rather than strings.
fields.label: Value (Number)

name: CRM Task Lead Snapshot
